snippet.title: Awaking Beauty Trailer ｜Let’s save the world through dreaming—together !
snippet.description:
"Awaking Beauty" is a dual-character roguelite action game that blends sci-fi and fantasy. You play as selected high school girls who pilot dream-traveling mechs to dive into surreal dreamscapes, defeating monsters born from nightmares and growing stronger along the way.

This is not just a story about girls saving the world, but also one about unity and mutual redemption.

The game supports both solo and two-player modes.

🔻"Awaking Beauty" on Steam🔻
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253950/Awaking_Beauty/
